title: A type-D4 counterexample to the canonical-potential exponent converse
description:
The exponent-bound converse stated for canonical GHKK potentials in Schumann's 2021 Oberwolfach report is false. For an explicit reduced word in type D4, the canonical potential has 22 combined monomials, all of coefficient one, and all 22 inequalities define distinct facets, although two monomials have exponent minus two in one canonical coordinate. The reduced word and its complete string-coordinate support occur in earlier public computations; we extract the consequence for the historical formulation and supply an independent canonical calculation and exact integer certificates. The chamber-ansatz pullback has all exponents in {-1,0,1}, so the later string-coordinate converse is not refuted. No first-priority or current-openness claim is made.

Extensively AI-assisted, unrefereed corrective and verification note. No external human peer review or formal proof-assistant certification. The reduced word and complete transformed support occur in Denis Mironov's older public crystal data, Case 267; no first discovery, first resolution, or current-openness claim is made. The deposit includes the five-page note and a portable source and exact-verification archive. The later string-coordinate and coefficient conjectures are not refuted.
